title: Lysine decarboxylase assay with cucurbituril \(cucurbit-7-uril)
protocol: Prepare the following stock solutions in 10 mM NH4OAc, pH 6.0: 500 μM cucurbituril, 25 μM dapoxyl, 1 mM lysine, 800 μg/ml lysine decarboxylase.
Add 100 μl of dapoxyl stock (25 μM) to the cuvette and add 780 μl buffer.
Place the cuvette into the fluorometer and start recording in kinetic mode (excitation = 336 nm, emission = 380 nm).
Add 20 μl of cucurbituril stock (500 μM) to the solution and wait until fluorescence intensity has equilibrated.
Add 50 μl of lysine stock (1 mM) to the solution.
Add 50 μl of lysine decarboxylase (800 μg/ml) to initiate the reaction and record fluorescence until no change in intensity is registered.
